title: Facile synthesis of TiO2–carbon composite doped nitrogen for efficient photodegradation of noxious methylene blue dye
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34298-34310
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05444J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Victor Onwubiko, Yoshihisa Matsushita, Emad A. Elshehy, Mohamed E. El-Khouly
The present work demonstrates that the introduction of a nitrogen-doped carbon framework, synthesized through a sol-hydrothermal method, significantly enhances the photocatalytic degradation behavior of TiO2 towards methylene blue (MB).
